subject: 航空公司飛行員招募與評鑑心理學 (Airline Pilot Selection & Assessment Psychology)

mc_questions.zh_question: 根據受訪專家 Guillaume Debauchez 的觀點，飛行員應試者必須具備的「基礎層面 (Foundation)」知識主要包含下列何者？
zh_options: (A) 心理測驗的作答技巧與模擬機科目演練
(B) 履歷 (CV) 與自傳 (Cover Letter) 的撰寫優化
(C) 瞭解招募官思維、公司價值觀及 CRM 運作邏輯
(D) 考題題庫的記憶與技術手冊的背誦
mc_questions.en_question: According to Guillaume Debauchez, what does the 'Foundation' level of knowledge primarily consist of for pilot candidates?
en_options: (A) Psychometric test techniques and simulator profile practice
(B) Optimization of CV and Cover Letter writing
(C) Understanding the recruiter's mindset, airline values, and CRM operational logic
(D) Memorizing question banks and technical manuals
mc_questions.explanation: Guillaume 強調 Foundation 是核心,包含理解招募官的需求 (recruiter mindset)、航空公司的營運與 CRM (Resource Management) 流程以及自我認知,而非僅是 Surface 層面的技術演練。

mc_questions.zh_question: 關於航空公司的招募錄取統計，專家提到大型航空公司（包含廉航與主流航空）典型的應徵者錄取率約為多少？
mc_questions.en_question: Regarding recruitment statistics, what is the typical success rate for applicants at major airline selections mentioned in the interview?
mc_questions.explanation: 影片中提到大型航空公司及有嚴格制度的招募流程中,典型的 Success rate (成功率) 約為 25%,意味著有 75% 的應徵者會被淘汰。

mc_questions.zh_question: 在 Guillaume 劃分的應徵者三種類別中，哪一類人最能透過專業培訓顯著提高成功率？
zh_options: (A) 頂尖 25%：天生具備業務與社交特質的人
(B) 底部 25%：反應較慢或適職測驗表現不佳的人
(C) 中間 50%：能力達標但缺乏招募官「解碼鑰匙」的人
(D) 已經具有多年飛行經驗且不需額外準備的人
mc_questions.en_question: Among the three categories of candidates described by Guillaume, which group can significantly improve their success rate through professional training?
en_options: (A) Top 25%: Those with natural sales and social traits
(B) Bottom 25%: Those who are slower or perform poorly in aptitude tests
(C) Middle 50%: Capable candidates who lack the 'decoding keys' for recruiters
(D) Experienced pilots who do not require additional preparation
mc_questions.explanation: 中間 50% 的應徵者具備基本素質,但常在面試中因誤解招募官意圖或自信心不足而受挫。透過培訓獲得 Decoding keys (解碼鑰匙) 後,成功率可大幅提升。

cloze_items.cloze_text: According to unofficial statistics from the French DGAC, {{c1::50%}} of ATPL holders do not renew their professional licenses after 3 years.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 根據法國民航總局 (DGAC) 的非官方統計，50% 的 ATPL 持有人在 3 年後沒有續聘/續發其專業執照。
cloze_items.explanation: 這項數據反映了許多人在取得執照後,因無法通過航空公司評鑑或環境因素而最終離開飛行產業。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Candidates often fail because they are left {{c1::guessing}} what the recruiter is looking for instead of performing at their best.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 應徵者常失敗是因為他們只能「猜測」招募官想要什麼,而不是展現最好的自己。
cloze_items.explanation: 缺乏對招募標準的理解會導致應試者在面試中過度焦慮並產生似是而非的表現。

cloze_items.cloze_text: The most daunting part of the assessment is the {{c1::psychologist}}, because candidates don't know what they will find out about them.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 評鑑中最令人畏懼的部分是「心理學家面試」，因為應徵者不知道對方會挖掘出自己什麼樣的一面。
cloze_items.explanation: 心理學家在評鑑中扮演關鍵角色,主要考察性格穩定性與潛在風險 (Risk assessment)。

cloze_items.cloze_text: For a pilot, the most important attribute during an assessment on the airplane or in an interview is {{c1::confidence}}.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 對於飛行員而言，在飛機評鑑或面試中最重要的人格特質是「自信心」。
cloze_items.explanation: 自信源於對 Foundation (基礎知識) 的掌握,若在受試中失去自信,將無法發揮應有的判斷力。

cloze_items.cloze_text: Recruiters use group exercises to see if you can lead with your best foot forward while still remaining an {{c1::honest}} person.
cloze_items.zh_translation: 招募官透過團體演練來觀察你是否能在展現領導力的同時，依然保持「誠實/真實」。
cloze_items.explanation: 航空公司的 CRM 評選標準強調真實性,刻意塑造出的完美形象通常會被識破。
